programs.title: Blue Planet 2
programs.desc: The deep ocean is as difficult to explore as space.The waters surrounding Antarctica are among the coldest on the planet.Paradoxically, in the depths, where no light reaches and the pressure seems deadly, there is an unimaginable abundance of life forms.It is assumed that in the so-called90% of all fish in the ocean live in the twilight zone.At night, huge schools of firefish swim to the surface to feed on plankton.During the day they hide again.Creatures living in the depths often resemble aliens and create stunning light shows to attract mates and deter predators.

programs.title: Ancient Egypt By Train
programs.desc: Professor Alice Roberts goes on a long journey to get to know Egypt better.Following the paths from the book he learned in childhood, "A Thousand Leagues on the Waves of the Nile", he goes from Cairo to the Great Pyramids.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are UK
programs.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programs.title: Earth: A Year In Orbit
programs.desc: A summary of key events that occurred on Earth in 2024.The authors use satellite photos to show global crises, natural phenomena and natural disasters.
